titulo: My Grandpa Called Me. Three Days After His Funeral | Urban Legend #Shorts
titulo_pt: Meu avô me ligou. Três dias depois do enterro | Lenda urbana
resumo_pt: Lenda das ligações dos mortos. Três dias depois do enterro do avô, o telefone fixo da casa dele toca de madrugada enquanto a narradora arruma as coisas. É a voz dele: 'Sai de casa agora. Não acende nada.' Ela sai, e os bombeiros acham um vazamento de gás na cozinha. A companhia telefônica confirma: aquela linha estava cortada desde o dia do enterro.
descricao:
The phone line had been dead for days.

Would you have answered?

scenes.text: My grandpa died. Three days later, I was alone, cleaning out his old house.
scenes.pt: Meu avô morreu. Três dias depois, eu tava sozinha, esvaziando a casa velha dele.
scenes.visual: old farmhouse at dusk, cardboard boxes on the porch

scenes.text: At two a.m., his old kitchen phone started ringing.
scenes.pt: Às duas da manhã, o telefone velho da cozinha começou a tocar.
scenes.visual: old rotary wall phone with a curly cord in a dim kitchen

scenes.text: I picked it up half asleep. Hello?
scenes.visual: woman holding an old phone receiver to her ear in a dark kitchen
close up of the old wall phone receiver against the narrator's ear, a faint ghostly silhouette of an old man reflected in the dark kitchen window

scenes.text: Get out of the house. Right now. Don't turn on any lights.
scenes.pt: Sai de casa. Agora. Não acende nenhuma luz.
scenes.visual: ghostly pale face of the grandpa glowing faintly in the dark kitchen window, urgent expression
phone receiver hanging by its cord in a dark kitchen

scenes.text: I ran outside barefoot and called nine-one-one.
scenes.pt: Saí correndo descalça e liguei pra emergência.
scenes.visual: barefoot woman running out of a farmhouse door at night

scenes.text: The firefighters found a gas leak in the kitchen.
scenes.pt: Os bombeiros acharam um vazamento de gás na cozinha.
scenes.visual: firefighters with flashlights inside an old kitchen at night

scenes.text: The whole house was full of it.
scenes.visual: firefighter holding a gas detector glowing red in the dark kitchen

scenes.text: One light switch, and it would've exploded.
scenes.pt: Um interruptor, e tudo teria explodido.
scenes.visual: close up of an old light switch on a kitchen wall

scenes.text: Nobody did. That line was disconnected the day of his funeral.
scenes.pt: Ninguém. Aquela linha foi cortada no dia do enterro dele.
scenes.visual: old wall phone with its cord unplugged, morning light

scenes.text: I kept that phone. It's on my kitchen wall now. Just in case.
scenes.pt: Eu fiquei com aquele telefone. Agora ele está na parede da minha cozinha. Só por garantia.
scenes.visual: old rotary phone hanging on a modern kitchen wall
